title: AisleCatalog service
description: Add `CookbookApp/ShoppingLists/AisleCatalog.swift` — an `@Observable` (iOS 17) service that calls the existing `AisleConfigParser.parse(_:)` from CookbookCore when the configured folder URL is set or changes, caches the result, and exposes `aisles: [String]` (ordered as in `aisle.conf`, lowercase as written) and `isLoaded: Bool`. When `aisle.conf` is absent or fails to parse, `aisles` falls back to the canonical default order: produce, herbs, meat, seafood, dairy, eggs, cheese, bakery, pantry, canned, frozen, spices, pasta, rice, flours, oils, nuts, sauces, juices, world, baking, alko.
acceptance_criteria: `load(from folderURL: URL)` reads `<folderURL>/aisle.conf`, parses it with `AisleConfigParser.parse`, and caches the ordered aisles list
`isLoaded` is false before first load and true after
Calling `load` a second time (folder change) replaces the cached list
Absent or unparseable `aisle.conf` falls back to the canonical default list
Does not re-implement any parsing logic from `AisleConfigParser`

handoff_summary.completed: Implemented `AisleCatalog` with `@Observable`, `load(from:)`, `aisles: [String]`, `isLoaded: Bool`, canonical fallback list, and security-scoped resource access matching the pattern in `ShoppingListFiles.swift`.
handoff_summary.risks: None. File is new, no existing code modified. The SourceKit 'No such module CookbookCore' warning is a worktree LSP artifact — the same import is used by 9 other CookbookApp files successfully.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify load/fallback behavior and that isLoaded transitions correctly.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — new file only, no modifications to shared code.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used `sections.isEmpty` as the fallback guard (rather than parse failure) because `AisleConfigParser.parse` never throws — an empty or comment-only file yields an `AisleConfig` with no sections, which is the correct signal for falling back to defaults.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Tester should cover: (1) valid aisle.conf → correct section-name order, (2) absent file → default list, (3) file with no sections → default list, (4) second load replaces first, (5) isLoaded false before load.

conflict_risks: None — new file only, no modifications to shared code.

execution_history.summary: Created `CookbookApp/ShoppingLists/AisleCatalog.swift` — an `@Observable` service that loads `aisle.conf` via `AisleConfigParser.parse(_:)`, caches section names as the `aisles` list, sets `isLoaded` after each load, and falls back to the canonical 22-item default when the file is absent or produces no sections.
